questiontext.text:
Consider the following research scenario:

{@q_text@}

Identify the specific method of data collection being used in this situation.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Correct answer: {@correct_text@}

Match each scenario to the method by its defining feature:

  • Observation: watching and recording behaviour as it happens naturally, without interacting.
  • Interview: a direct conversation to gather detailed, in-depth answers from a person or small group.
  • Questionnaire: a standard set of written questions used to gather data quickly from many people.
  • Experimentation: manipulating one factor while controlling others to test cause and effect.
  • Secondary Data Collection: using existing data already collected and recorded by someone else.

questiondescription.text:
Daniel Murunga

Methods of data collection: identifying the method (Observation, Interview, Questionnaire, Experimentation, Secondary Data) from a described scenario.

Ben (STACK audit)

Students read a randomised real-world scenario describing a data-gathering activity and identify the method used. Methods restricted to the five taught in the lesson; each wrong answer receives a diagnostic hint pointing at the correct method's defining feature.

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

feedbackvariables.text: hint: if is(correct_text = "Observation") then "This scenario involves watching and recording behaviour as it naturally happens, without interacting with the subjects." elseif is(correct_text = "Interview") then "This scenario involves a direct conversation to gather detailed, in-depth answers from a person or small group." elseif is(correct_text = "Questionnaire") then "This scenario uses a standard set of written questions to gather data quickly from a large number of people." elseif is(correct_text = "Experimentation") then "This scenario manipulates one factor while keeping the others fixed, to test its effect (cause and effect)." else "This scenario uses data that was already collected and recorded by someone else for another purpose.";

falsefeedback.text: Not quite. {@hint@} Which method does that describe?

qtest.description: A distractor selected: fires the F branch with the diagnostic hint.
